_comment: Manual annotations merged into data.json by scripts/generate_data.py. Keyed by entry id (github owner/repo, lowercase). unifi_os.status: works | partial | broken | unknown. versions: subset of ["3","4","5"]. These survive regeneration; edit here, never in data.json.

unifi_os.notes: Installs and persists the CrowdSec firewall bouncer on UniFi OS consoles; documented on UniFi OS 3.x and 4.x devices including UCG Fiber.
iptables LOG rules and parsers for UniFi Dream Machines running UniFi OS.
On-device utilities for UDM-family consoles; project README documents UniFi OS 3.x and 4.x support.
Policy-based split tunnel on UniFi OS gateways (UDM family).
Runs Tailscale on UDM-family consoles; install script handles UniFi OS persistence across firmware updates.
Let's Encrypt certificates for UniFi OS consoles; deployed on-device via unifios-utilities boot script.
Polls the controller API, so support tracks the UniFi Network Application rather than device firmware; documented against UniFi OS consoles.
